_about: Corrections to the model catalog, which is otherwise built from ComfyUI's workflow templates and the makers' Hugging Face repos (engine/zentrainer/models/families.py). Read by the engine when it builds the catalog, and by the web app when it's built.

families: the first entry whose `match` (a regex on the family id) fits applies. maker: who makes it. logo: a file in web/public/logos/ (64 px, transparent). mono: a black-on-transparent logo, shown white on dark themes. name: rename the family. hide: leave it out of the catalog. source: where the logo came from. other: listed under "Other models" in the picker instead of the main list (models few people train).
text_encoder_skip: text encoder files (regexes) that load through CLIPLoader but aren't the model's text encoder (prompt upsamplers, enhancers, rewriters).

tested: the family ids that have trained end to end here (a recipe, a real-ComfyUI smoke test in tests/comfy, or a run checked by hand). The pickers list these as models; every other family, a new one the catalog finds included, is under "Other models", marked untested, until someone trains it and adds its id.

families.note: Ming 3.0 TTS: a text-to-speech model, not something ZenTrainer trains
